title: Link the extension-pack schema where people look for it
goal: docs/extension-pack.md documents the extension pack manifest schema with a table of required fields, and nothing links to it: config/README.md names the bundled pack and README explains extension packs, but neither points at the schema, so the one document that answers what a manifest needs is invisible. Link it from both places. Deleting it would have destroyed accurate documentation of a live feature - the gap was discoverability, not obsolescence.
